# file-integrity

File Integrity Operator running AIDE on every node and reporting changed files

Guide: https://policystk.io/elements/file-integrity/

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  fileIntegrity:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

One FileIntegrity, file-integrity, runs AIDE on every Linux node whatever its taints. Its AIDE configuration is the operator's default plus aideExclusions.

Under `stack.fileIntegrity.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `gracePeriod` | Seconds between AIDE scans on each node | `900` |
| `aideExclusions` | Host paths AIDE skips on top of the operator's default exclusions. Path: reason. A path is an absolute AIDE regular expression matched from the start, so a directory covers everything under it. null in a later layer removes an entry. |  |
| `aideExclusions./etc/machine-config-daemon/previous-logs` | Not in the operator's default: without it every machine config daemon restart fails the node | `The machine config daemon copies its log here on every restart` |

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-file-integrity` | `file-integrity-operator` | `stable` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-file-integrity` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: SI-7 Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity. Categories: SI System and Information Integrity.

### Policy `config`

`config-file-integrity-<cluster>`: Configure AIDE and deploy the FileIntegrity instance. Depends on `install-file-integrity-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config-file-integrity` | enforce | high | `install-file-integrity-status`<br>compliant while pending | [file-integrity](converters/config/file-integrity.yaml) | Namespace pod security label, AIDE configuration and the FileIntegrity instance |

### Policy `findings`

`findings-file-integrity-<cluster>`: AIDE not running, or nodes whose latest scan found changed files or failed. Depends on `config-file-integrity-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `findings-file-integrity-active` | inform (always) | high | [file-integrity-active](converters/findings/file-integrity-active.yaml) | FileIntegrity phase Active |
| `findings-file-integrity-nodes` | inform (always) | high | [file-integrity-nodes](converters/findings/file-integrity-nodes.yaml) (mustnothave) | FileIntegrityNodeStatus with a Failed or Errored latest result |

### Policy `install`

`install-file-integrity-<cluster>`: Install and manage the File Integrity Operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-file-integrity` | enforce | medium | [operator](#operators) `file-integrity-operator` | File Integrity Operator |
